§6Super-Laminar Fluiduct§f

§aMaximum fluid throughput for your endgame refineries and high-volume coolant loops!§f

§bSuper-Laminar Fluiducts§f are the top-tier fluid duct with best possible throughput, crafted with §bEnderium§f. Required for any large-scale fluid operation that outpaces Signalum-Plated.

§6Crafting§f:
§b• Transparent§f: §e1× Enderium Ingot§f + §e1× Glass§f → §e6× Super-Laminar Fluiduct§f.
§b• Opaque§f: §e1× Enderium Ingot§f + §e1× Lead Ingot§f → §e6× Super-Laminar Fluiduct (Opaque)§f.

Use cases: refinery outputs exceeding §e10,000 mB/tick§f per side, §bMagmatic Dynamo§f coolant loops with §bGelid Cryotheum§f, NuclearCraft heat exchanger circuits.

§eTip§f: Only Super-Laminar can keep up with a fully-fueled §bMagmatic Dynamo§f burning §bBlazing Pyrotheum§f. Plan for these at the end of your duct line.
